newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat shares at lowest for over two years.
newsitem.headline: Fiat shares at lowest for over two years.

text.p: Shares in Italian carmaker and industrial giant Fiat Spa fell to their lowest level since January 1994 after breaching a key psychological level at 4,500 lire per share, dealers said.

While the Milan bourse was down around 1.4 percent, Fiat ordinary shares were quoted 2.56 percent lower on the day at 4,480, above the session's low of 4,470. Turnover was three million shares by 1035 GMT.
Fiat stocks have not been this low since January 28, 1994 when they were quoted at 4,431 lire.
"The ugly outlook on the car market is continuing to weigh on the share," a dealer here said. Data on car registrations for August are due on September 10.
